To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a high-efficiency inductive wireless power system is proposed for the on-board charger of electric vehicles.
the proposed system is able to provide a high power transfer efficiency of 97.08%, a wide load range from 2 kW to 6.6 kW, and an output voltage range of 100–400 V.

the proposed system has the following advantages: (a) the proposed system has a high power transfer efficiency, which is about 97% at the output power of 3.7kW, (b) the proposed system is capable of implementing a CC and a CV mode charge, (c) all the switching devices are fully soft switched in both the CC mode and CV mode charge, and (d) the proposed system does not need any bulky ferrite cores to improve the power efficiency

the development and implementation of an on-board charger for electric vehicles.
the development of a wireless charging system for electric vehicles.
the design, analysis, and optimization of a novel wireless power transfer system.

the proposed method can be used for the on-board charging of electric vehicles.
the proposed system can provide a high efficiency wireless power transfer for the on-board charger of electric vehicles.

this paper proposes an inductive wireless power system with two intermediate coils for the on-board charger of electric vehicles, and the proposed system can be operated in the CC and CV modes of charge operation with a fixed frequency.

the proposed system has a high dc to dc efficiency of 96% at 6.6 kW and 200 mm air-gap distance.
a wireless power transfer (WPT) system with a high efficiency is proposed.
the proposed wireless power transfer system is a promising solution for the on-board charging of electric vehicles with high efficiency and low cost.

the proposed system can be used for the on-board battery chargers of electric vehicle with high efficiency, high power transfer, and soft switching of all switching devices.
